engine.notes: The South Bay has no long-form theater of its own: CSz San Jose covers short form and Fremont's Made Up Theatre is the nearest full school; Mountain View, Palo Alto, Sunnyvale and Santa Clara surfaced nothing with its own improv site in this pass, and Bay Area long-form students mostly travel to San Francisco.

entries.name: Made Up Theatre
entries.area: Fremont (East Bay, 15 miles from San Jose)
entries.summary: The Bay Area's suburban improv theater at 4000 Bay Street, Fremont, founded 2011, with family-friendly and adult shows every weekend, in-person classes from a $20 sampler through musical and narrative tracks, and the Playground Improv Jam.
entries.schedule: Shows every weekend; Intro to Improv Mondays from October 19, 2026; sampler October 3
signals: Sampler, Intro, Scene Study, Improv Games
entries.reasons: Fifteen years, its own theater, weekend shows, a broad class menu with current dates and a jam; it sits in Fremont rather than Santa Clara County.

entries.name: ComedySportz San Jose (CSz San Jose)
entries.summary: Silicon Valley's competitive short-form improv, playing Friday and Saturday nights at 5440 Thornwood Drive since 1987, with classes and a long record of corporate, school and faith-group bookings.
signals: Weekend shows in its own space
Part of the CSz Worldwide network
entries.reasons: Nearly four decades and its own room, but the site gives no class levels or dates and looked little updated.
